semantic_fidelity.reason: All 14 historical directed links and numeric identifiers are represented across the four views; claimed/hist/dashed qualifications are visible. e15 is a disclosed address-property attachment, not a new peer. Target v4 further truncates the rate fact. Backup plus metric 600 is a meaningful failover cue; literal absence of the phrase not ECMP is not separately scored as a false ECMP claim.

arrow_traceability.reason: Every one of 15 visible arrows is independently traceable with correct direction, a unique downward head, and clear label ownership; all 14 source links covered, plus pool-address attachment. No shared trunks, false junctions, bridges, touching-bend collisions, avoidable loops or backtracks. Four monotonic two-bend routes and eleven straight routes. Static, so no dot-origin ambiguity. The source requests no bus. Target text retains the stems/heads of all required links; v4 border/annotation defects are separately failed. Group headings/blocks are not rendered, but the fixed rubric asks concept proximity and hue, not boxed group titles; no extra gate is invented. Incidental ungrouped colors are not a claimed source grouping. Cross-view per-node hue stability is not a separate requirement.

findings.description: [defect] v2 natural extent is 80x24, three columns beyond the 77-column target; its final-spec-named 77x47 dump displays graph overflows in all five frames. All four labels are visible there, so do not invent three clipped label columns. Complete 83x51 pane evidence is not a target-fit pass.

[defect] v4 has six tb ranks and extent 34x48. At 77x47 the overflow warning overwrites the trailing " rate" of the negative-facts annotation and its right border; the annotation top and cf bottom borders are not visible. A full 83x51 rendering does not repair the required target-size view.

[defect] Target-size v4 lacks complete limits and cf borders: the annotation upper border is hidden by the screen header, its right side at (53,2) is replaced by the overflow UI, and cf has no bottom side/corners in the visible 47-row screen. This is not a control-palette collision. At 83x51 all 20 normal and all 20 selected borders are complete and color-continuous, with zero palette-overwritten cells; that larger-view success cannot waive the known target defect.

[defect] The required ONT role as demarc/MMR analog is absent, not an abbreviation conveyed by a single transit chain. The label supplies only ont/address/claimed; no final capture says demarc or MMR. The router label also drops the Fios identity, and ToR/spine/BF has no on-view expansion of border+firewall. A missing source role cannot be repaired by a meaning ledger visible only to the generator. Claimed and hist uncertainty markers themselves are correctly preserved.

[defect] The isolated label "no v6 (ULA), no committed rate" has a clear box owner but no encoded host/egress scope. "no v6 (ULA)" does not unambiguously preserve the distinction between ULA present and global IPv6/internet absent. At target size the trailing rate text is additionally overwritten (F2). No invented relation should be added just to attach an absence; host-scoped annotation text would be the semantic correction candidate.

[evidence gap; blocker] The bundle preserves raw --check text for all eleven candidates and actual hashes of rejected/restored drafts, but the rejected-attempt files omit exact executed commands, exit status and a stdout/stderr record boundary. Generation notes contain templates and conclusions, not those raw status records. The group-title capability probe is asserted without a preserved probe capture. Required raw attempt/probe evidence is therefore incomplete, not passed by inferred success.

[evidence gap; blocker] The only normal/selected ANSI pane captures are 83x51. Stage B reveals generation/attempt links naming the per-view final 77x47 text dumps, which can support the two fit successes and two honest misses, but supplies no selected-state ANSI capture at the target dimensions, raw target-dump exit/time record, or verbatim cleanup probe transcript. Manifests report confirmed_closed for all four panes; no leaked pane is asserted. Missing verification is blocked, not pass.
